authority_rule: Level E advice cannot enter an executable contract without scoped support from higher authority or prospective calibration.

statements.executable_disposition: Implement as an authority firewall and never treat lane agreement as physical validation.
statements.finding: Separate custody, metrology, adjudication, and action authority; the labels are a new governance design, not a recovered law.
statements.statement: Four-lane separation is a valid governance architecture.

statements.executable_disposition: Exclude TORUS-BROT presets from confirmatory evidence channels.
statements.finding: The constructed analytic family may aid navigation and sensitivity visualization but cannot establish a physical 14-fold law.
statements.statement: TORUS-BROT is navigation or visualization rather than physical evidence by itself.

statements.executable_disposition: Do not label a geometry pack ToT-BROT without registered coupled invariants and null tests.
statements.finding: ToT-BROT requires explicit coupled-system or inter-projection invariants; multiple views of one field are insufficient.
statements.statement: TORUS-BROT and ToT-BROT are distinct.

statements.executable_disposition: Create a new versioned standard and preserve v2.1 unchanged.
statements.finding: v2.1 is one-dimensional; geometry-indexed packs are a new v3 extension with a documented migration boundary.
statements.statement: Geometry-indexed domain packs are already part of canonical TLD v2.1.

statements.executable_disposition: Do not import 1e-9; retain a mutation that rejects any future claim-bearing absolute threshold.
statements.finding: The repository audit found 1e-9 only as numerical denominator/variance floors, not a claim-bearing curvature prominence gate.
statements.statement: A claim-bearing absolute 1e-9 curvature threshold is currently active in TFS.

statements.executable_disposition: Calibrate a small candidate family on synthetic and historical controls before any freeze.
statements.finding: The current ControllerGate elbow is explicitly noncanonical and the historical formula was not recovered.
statements.statement: Scale-relative or null-standardized curvature is preferable to an uncalibrated absolute prominence.

statements.executable_disposition: Route only NOISY_NUMERIC measurements through registered variance-floor analysis.
statements.finding: Variance-floor analysis is relevant to noisy numeric observables, not deterministic semantic assertions.
statements.statement: Shot-noise or variance-floor analysis is required for every observable.

statements.executable_disposition: Keep out of method calibration and claim-bearing baselines.
statements.finding: Historical discussion supports the claim, but no raw bytes, executable code, and verified result artifact were admitted into this audit.
statements.statement: A 50 MB /dev/urandom run established a negative result and exposed whitening concerns.

statements.executable_disposition: Prohibit the claim until a complete custody chain and independent verification exist.
statements.finding: Only a proposed retry was located; no exact raw dataset, code, hashes, or verified result artifact was found.
statements.statement: A positive 200 MB CPU-jitter 1/14 result was completed and verified.

statements.executable_disposition: Exclude from all contracts and publications.
statements.finding: No source file, raw data, hash, executable result, normalization definition, or independent verification was found.
statements.statement: A 10 MB entropy_drift_pure.py run verified normalized autocorrelation rho(lag 18)=106.9%.

statements.executable_disposition: Use clean replay plus duplicate clean replay for deterministic semantic assertions.
statements.finding: Repeated randomized probes are conditional on noise, flakiness, stochastic behavior, timing, resources, or a registered perturbation family.
statements.statement: All probes should be ensemble averaged.

statements.executable_disposition: Detect flat/tied traces and report boundary rate; do not treat N=6 as a structural scale.
statements.finding: A pilot record reports nine-way minimum ties for 74% of evaluated ladders, which can pin naive argmin to N=6; this is pilot-specific degeneracy evidence.
statements.statement: N=6 boundary attraction is a universal structural finding.

statements.executable_disposition: Measure orbit length in Scout; do not hardcode two.
statements.finding: Short orbits are discussed, but an exact universal orbit-length distribution was not recovered.
statements.statement: Every N=6 winner has orbit length exactly two.

statements.executable_disposition: Report it and calibrate any threshold on synthetic/historical controls.
statements.finding: Orbit length can diagnose degeneracy but has no historically validated universal cutoff.
statements.statement: Orbit length is a useful pre-closure eligibility diagnostic.

statements.executable_disposition: Make GeometryScoutV1 a hard upstream gate.
statements.finding: Unmaterialized, degenerate, ambiguous, under-supported, or null-incomplete fields cannot support closure claims.
statements.statement: Eligibility must be established before closure or emergence is computed.

statements.executable_disposition: Export shadow evidence only; preserve the ControllerGate authority firewall.
statements.finding: Structured fragility may support metrology, but topology/metrology has no source ownership, patch, count, or terminal authority.
statements.statement: Structured fragility can directly validate or authorize a ControllerGate repair.

statements.executable_disposition: Do not encode 21.43%; report actual eligible support and calibrated requirements.
statements.finding: No calibrated universal threshold was found; materialization is domain- and cohort-specific.
statements.statement: 21.43 percent materialization is a universal pass threshold or bottleneck constant.

statements.executable_disposition: No AMDS threshold may enter the TFS method or ControllerGate transfer as validated.
statements.finding: AMDS prospective effectiveness is NOT_ESTABLISHED and no cross-domain geometry-TLD confidence calibration was found.
statements.statement: Static AMDS confidence thresholds are established for geometry-TLD evidence.

statements.executable_disposition: Keep timing non-authoritative and require causal evidence through the owning domain contract.
statements.finding: Timing is telemetry requiring randomized repeated measurement and still cannot establish source ownership by itself.
statements.statement: A single timing or resource run can establish causal attribution.

statements.executable_disposition: Use the executable five-part support rule, never the slogan.
statements.finding: Arbitrary destruction can remove valid structure; support requires matched nulls, registered fragility, meaningful perturbations, faithful representations, and baseline exclusion.
statements.statement: Real structure survives its own destruction.

statements.executable_disposition: Treat interior-only relative curvature as a new candidate subject to calibration.
statements.finding: Current code labels the proposal noncanonical and historical recovery NOT_ESTABLISHED/NOT_RECOVERED.
statements.statement: winner_N_elbow is a recovered canonical historical formula.

statements.executable_disposition: Exclude endpoints and mutation-test against padding leakage.
statements.finding: A centered second difference requires both neighbors, so only N=7..13 are eligible without a separately justified boundary model.
statements.statement: Endpoint-padded curvature on N=6..14 is valid for elbow selection.

statements.executable_disposition: Provide an optional domain-specific sensitivity contract; import no -45/-25 dB constants.
statements.finding: The metrological principle is sound when units, response, noise floor, and target band are registered; the supplied PAT/Talbot/TCXO numbers were not independently verified.
statements.statement: Insufficient registered instrument sensitivity should yield INCONCLUSIVE rather than NEGATIVE.

statements.executable_disposition: Exclude the exact interval from the geometry method.
statements.finding: No authoritative source, instrument calibration, or executable contract for these numbers was located.
statements.statement: The -45 dB to -25 dB PAT sideband interval is an established TFS-wide standard.

statements.executable_disposition: Report an evidence vector unless a registered cross-modal calibration or hierarchical model is validated.
statements.finding: Incomparable scores lack a common estimand and calibration.
statements.statement: Numerically averaging uncalibrated modalities yields a valid global confidence score.

statements.executable_disposition: Freeze separate evidence channels for v0.3.0 and forbid uncalibrated numeric pooling.
statements.finding: Logical intersection is a safe default, not a universal theorem; calibrated hierarchical models may later be valid.
statements.statement: Different modalities may interface only through logical intersection.

statements.executable_disposition: State only the current scoped promotion requirement and preserve downstream count/repair gates.
statements.finding: Current canonical promotion requires a ControllerAudit receipt; the broader universal wording was not exhaustively proven across all historical states.
statements.statement: ControllerAudit is the sole writer of every ControllerGate terminal success state.

statements.executable_disposition: Implement observable classes with registered repeat, randomization, and replay policies.
statements.finding: The partition is sound, but deterministic semantics require an authorized run and duplicate clean replay when claim-bearing, not necessarily a literal sterile container in every local test.
statements.statement: MeasurementRepeatPolicyV1 should separate stochastic/resource observables from deterministic semantics.
